Prompt for failure skill induction
You are building a coding skill library for an AI software engineering agent. Each skill captures a reusable
implementation pattern for a specific type of coding task.
Task context
Problem family: {{QUESTION_TEXT}}
Trajectories
{{FAILED_CASES_BLOCK}}
These agents failed. Identify only strongly supported implementation mistakes and the actionable corrective
approach—for example, wrong algorithm choice, missed edge cases, poor debugging strategy, or environment
misunderstandings.
Selection policy
Keep only high-value, transferable, non-trivial patterns. Do not emit generic advice, task-specific quirks, or
patterns tied to file names, repository names, or task IDs. Prefer returning [] over weak or speculative skills.
Output format
Return ONLY a JSON array of operation objects. Supported operations are:
create: {"action":"create", "name":"...", "description":"Load when ...", "body":"..."}
update: {"action":"update", "target":"existing-skill-slug", "name":"...",
"description":"...", "body":"..."}
delete: {"action":"delete", "target":"existing-skill-slug"}

Prompt for unlabeled skill
You are building a situational skill library for an AI agent. Each skill captures a reusable pattern for a specific
type of task—when to use it and how to succeed.
Task context
Question family these trajectories address: {question}
{policy_section}
Trajectories
The trajectories below are UNLABELED. You are not told which trajectories are correct or incorrect. Any explicit
correctness annotations were removed.
Study all conversations critically and infer likely strong vs. weak approaches based on internal evidence:
• Which tools were called and in what order
• What arguments were passed
• Whether the approach appears to satisfy the user request and constraints
• Signs of weak reasoning: wrong tool choice, redundant calls, missing checks, stopping too early, contradictions
UNLABELED trajectories:
{unlabeled_text}
Your job
Infer likely stronger vs. weaker trajectories from internal evidence. Identify only the most important reusable
procedural patterns that separate reliable behavior from unreliable.
Only include a pattern if it is specific, transferable, non-obvious, and likely to materially improve future
behavior. When evidence is ambiguous, skip or return [].
{strict_selection}
Already existing skills (do not duplicate)
{existing_text}
Before creating a new skill, compare with existing skills and decide create/update/delete. Prefer revising
existing skills over adding siblings.
Output schema
{operation_schema_situational}

无标签技能提示词

你正在为 AI 智能体构建情境技能库。每个技能捕捉特定任务类型的可复用模式——何时使用，以及如何成功。

任务上下文
这些轨迹处理的问题族：{question}
{policy_section}

轨迹
下方轨迹没有标签。不会告知哪些轨迹正确或错误。任何显式正确性标注均已移除。

批判性地研究所有对话，依据内部证据推断可能较强与较弱的方法：
• 调用了哪些工具，顺序如何
• 传入了哪些参数
• 方法是否看起来满足用户请求和约束
• 薄弱推理的迹象：工具选择错误、冗余调用、遗漏检查、过早停止、矛盾

无标签轨迹：
{unlabeled_text}

你的工作
从内部证据推断可能较强与较弱的轨迹。只识别区分可靠行为与不可靠行为的最重要、可复用程序模式。

只有当模式具体、可迁移、非显而易见，且可能实质改善未来行为时，才包含它。证据含糊时，跳过或返回 []。
{strict_selection}

已有技能（不要重复）
{existing_text}

在创建新技能前，与已有技能比较，决定 create/update/delete。优先修改已有技能，而不是添加相近技能。

输出模式
{operation_schema_situational}

en:
Prompt for self-generated skill
You are building an agent skill library for the {{DOMAIN_NAME}} domain. A skill is a pre-written subroutine—a
shortcut the agent loads to complete a task via a direct, known-good tool-call sequence instead of re-deriving the
procedure each time.
Domain Policy
{{DOMAIN_POLICY}}
Available Tools
{{TOOL_DEFINITIONS}}
Task Types (representative sample; treat as abstract)
{{TASK_TYPES}}
Existing skills (do not duplicate)
Your task
Generate up to {{OP_BUDGET}} high-value operations. For each task type, ask:
• Is there a well-defined direct tool-call sequence that resolves this correctly?
• Are there unnecessary calls agents might make before reaching the correct path?
• Is there a policy rule or decision boundary that eliminates exploratory calls?
Only create/update a skill if a genuine shortcut exists—a known-good sequence shorter than what a naive agent
would attempt. Do not create skills for tasks requiring exploration.
Selection policy (high bar)
• Identify candidates mentally, then keep only top 1–{{OP_BUDGET}}.
• Prefer 0–2 strong operations over broad coverage.
Output format
Return ONLY a JSON array of operation objects. Return [] if nothing passes the high bar.
create: {"action":"create", "name":"...", "description":"Load when <scenario>. Use this
skill to <shortcut>.", "body":"..."}
update: {"action":"update", "target":"existing-skill-slug", "name":"...",
"description":"...", "body":"..."}
delete: {"action":"delete", "target":"existing-skill-slug"}
Rules
• Prefer update over create for similar patterns.
• Use delete for duplicates or low-value skills.
• Body must include Common Issues and Direct Path.
• Description must explicitly state when to load (“Load when. . . ”).
zh:
自生成技能提示词

你正在为 {{DOMAIN_NAME}} 领域构建智能体技能库。技能是一种预先编写的子程序——智能体加载的捷径，通过直接、已知正确的工具调用序列完成任务，而不是每次重新推导程序。

领域政策
{{DOMAIN_POLICY}}

可用工具
{{TOOL_DEFINITIONS}}

任务类型（代表性样本；视为抽象类型）
{{TASK_TYPES}}

已有技能（不要重复）

你的任务
生成至多 {{OP_BUDGET}} 个高价值操作。对每种任务类型，询问：
• 是否有明确界定、可以正确解决它的直接工具调用序列？
• 智能体在到达正确路径前，是否可能进行不必要的调用？
• 是否有政策规则或决策边界能消除探索性调用？

只有确实存在捷径时才创建／更新技能——即已知正确、比朴素智能体尝试的序列更短的序列。不要为需要探索的任务创建技能。

选择策略（高标准）
• 在心中识别候选，然后只保留最好的 1–{{OP_BUDGET}} 个。
• 宁可选择 0–2 个强操作，也不要追求广泛覆盖。

输出格式
只返回操作对象的 JSON 数组。如果没有任何候选通过高标准，返回 []。
create: {"action":"create", "name":"...", "description":"在 <场景> 时加载。使用此技能来 <捷径>。", "body":"..."}
update: {"action":"update", "target":"existing-skill-slug", "name":"...", "description":"...", "body":"..."}
delete: {"action":"delete", "target":"existing-skill-slug"}

规则
• 对相似模式，优先 update 而非 create。
• 对重复或低价值技能，使用 delete。
• 正文必须包含 Common Issues（常见问题）和 Direct Path（直接路径）。
• 描述必须明确说明何时加载（“Load when…”）。
